messages:
jamie_peopleops: Quick routing — comp-band exception for Senior Data Engineer (Offer O-4681). Hiring mgr Lina requesting Market+10% to match counter; candidate R. Kaur wants start 2026-05-18 and benefits day-1 due to relocation. Also asking for a relocation stipend or sign-on. Need finance + comp-committee approvals ASAP (72h window).

alex_recruiter: Candidate gave verbal counter: +10% and $15k relocation OR $10k sign-on. They're US citizen, no visa. Wants clarity on benefits start before signing.

lina_hiringmgr: +1 on urgency. We can justify uplift with scarce skillset and strong pipeline risk. Start date of 5/18 is important for project ramp.

jamie_peopleops: Compensation snapshot:
```
Base: $185,000
Request: +10% uplift -> $203,500
Target bonus: 15%
Equity: 0.25% 4y
Sign-on requested: $10,000 (or relocation $15,000)
```
Can finance confirm sign-on budget and comp-committee route?

ben_finance: tagging @ben_finance — need cost center and GL coding. We can approve a one-time sign-on up to $12k from hiring contingency. For a permanent base uplift to market+10% we need comp-committee sign-off. Please provide peer comp lines (3) and manager justification.

jamie_peopleops: Routing to comp-committee. Adding manager justification and two peer comps now. Also proposing fallback: offer market+8% + $10k sign-on if committee wants compromise; start date flexibility to 6/01 if benefits backdate can't be accommodated.

maya_compchair: Reviewed the packet. Provisional approval for market+8% and $10k sign-on. Full +10% needs exec approval; we can escalate but will take longer. Manager, please confirm peer comps and business impact statement.

lina_hiringmgr: Peer comps attached (internal SDE3 averages and recent hires). Business impact: replaces departed senior contributor and reduces 6mo delivery risk on ingestion pipeline. We can accept +8% + $10k sign-on if committee prefers.

alex_recruiter: Candidate replied — they'd accept +8% + $10k sign-on if benefits can start 5/18. Candidate prefers earlier start. Please confirm benefits enrollment policy for backdating due to relocation.

jamie_peopleops: Confirmed with benefits: we can set benefits eligibility date to official start (5/18) for active relocation cases provided preboard forms are completed and move documentation is submitted within 30 days. I'll note required docs: lease/travel receipts or relocation invoice.

ben_finance: Confirmed cost center 4103-ENG and GL code 5472. Approving $10k sign-on from hiring contingency. Comp uplift to +8% approved by comp-committee.

offer-bot: Offer O-4681 created and updated: status = pending_signature -> approved by finance + comp-committee. Link: https://redwood/hr/offers/O-4681

jamie_peopleops: Final summary: approved package = base $199,800 (approx +8%), 15% target bonus, equity 0.25%, $10k sign-on, benefits effective 2026-05-18, relocation docs required. Hiring mgr please confirm start logistics; recruiter to send final offer packet within 24h.

lina_hiringmgr: Confirmed. Onboarding kickoff scheduled for 2026-05-18. Thanks team. :tada:

alex_recruiter: Sending final offer now. Will mark candidate as accepted when signed.

offer-bot: Offer O-4681 status: signed (candidate accepted). HRIS updated, benefits enrollment queued for 2026-05-18.

jamie_peopleops: Closing thread — saved approvals to file O-4681 and updated headcount tracker. If relocation reimbursements come in, route expense to ben_finance for processing.
